description: Vegan cooking centers on nutritional yeast, legumes, and olive oil. Plant-forward cooking with global spice access — technique over tradition lock-in.

attributes.micro_lesson: Roast vegetables deeply, use nutritional yeast and miso for umami, acid and crunch for finish.
attributes.shopping_tip: Legumes, grains, olive oil, and bold spice rack.
flavor_building: Start with olive oil as your cooking medium.
Season with nutritional yeast — toast or bloom in fat when using ground spices.
Build the plate around legumes as the anchor.
cultural_notes: Respect Vegan food as living tradition — learn context, not just copycat recipes.
